order_number.description: Full Circle order number exactly as given in the F999 row.

customer_reference.description: The customer's own PO, BOL or reference from the F999 row. Null if none.

status_changed.description: True only if class, ETA or location differs from the last update SBS sent.

current_location.description: City, State from the newest evidence. Null if not stated anywhere.

eta.description: ISO 8601 date-time for delivery from the newest evidence. Null if no source states one.

eta_timezone.description: IANA zone of the delivery location, for example America/Los_Angeles.

evidence.description: One line quoting or citing the evidence the status rests on, with its timestamp.

discrepancy.description: One line when Full Circle and carrier email disagree. Null otherwise.

reason.description: One sentence for the rep: why this class and this confidence.

body.description: Three to six lines, plain text.
